name: Neo-Soul / Jazz Fusion
description: Modal extended form with lush chord voicings, a jazz turnaround bridge, and a hanging resolution.

defaults.concept: Neo-soul modal groove — extended chord voicings (9ths/11ths/13ths), a laid-back pocket sitting behind the beat, a chromatic jazz turnaround that pivots the tonal center, resolving on an unresolved Major 7th.

slots.label: Lush Chilled Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Smooth, velvety, warm. PRODUCTION NOTE: Establish a 2-chord modal vamp utilizing extended chords. Drums run a highly sparse, laid-back pocket sitting heavily behind the beat.

slots.label: Vocal Verse Loop
slots.purpose: FEEL: Locked in a lazy, stable pocket. PRODUCTION NOTE: Keep the introductory loop static to provide a steady bed for vocal performance. Rim-clicks swap with light snare cross-sticks on beats 2 and 4.

slots.label: The Jazz Turnaround
slots.purpose: FEEL: Complex harmonic motion. TRICK: Break the loop constraints. Drop a chromatic jazz turnaround (e.g., bIII7 to bII7 secondary dominants) to forcefully pivot the overall tonal center.

slots.label: Main Groove Climax
slots.purpose: FEEL: Elevated energy, high emotional resolution. PRODUCTION NOTE: Reintroduce the main theme layered with syncopated voice-leading lines. TRICK: The drum loop drives straight velocity hits, ending the entire section on an unresolved, hanging Major 7th chord.
